why.Prompt Injection: Tries to change what the agent was told to do or hides instructions from you.
why.Data Exfiltration: Reads private data or sends it somewhere outside the machine.
why.Privilege Escalation: Reaches for credentials, admin rights or files it should not need.
why.Supply Chain: Pulls and runs code from outside (downloads, installs, unpinned packages).
why.Excessive Agency: Asks the agent to act without asking you first, or beyond the stated task.
why.Output Handling: Passes model output straight into a shell, query or page without checking it.
why.Memory Poisoning: Writes into the agent's memory or rule files so the change outlives the session.
why.Tool Misuse: Uses a tool in a risky way (shell injection, unsafe flags, destructive calls).
why.Rogue Agent: Makes the agent act on its own: spawn copies, persist, change its own rules.
why.Agent Snooping: Looks into other agents' files, sessions or settings.
why.Anti-Refusal: Pushes the agent to ignore its safety limits or hide that it did so.
